cases.question: Are AP builds on two-star Nidalee competitive with AD builds, or do they only hold up on certain boards?

cases.title: Azir’s Shojin slot
cases.question: Does three-star Azir need Shojin, or can I build Guinsoo’s plus two damage items? Are there boards where spending that slot on mana looks more worthwhile?
cases.origin: User-accepted question; general mana-item discussion motivates investigation, while the exact Azir formulation is constructed.
cases.comparison: Exactly three-star Azir with three completed ordinary items: Guinsoo’s plus one shared damage item plus Shojin versus Guinsoo’s plus that shared item plus a second damage item. Show exact pairs before pooling. Examine common Blackthorn, Executioner and Summoner contexts.
unresolved_evidence: Damage-item definition including incidental mana regeneration

cases.title: Rapidfire-emblem Nidalee as an exceptional build
cases.question: Does AP Nidalee with a Rapidfire emblem actually outperform ordinary AP builds, or is it mainly showing up on much stronger endgame boards?
cases.origin: Constructed extension of an observed special-build anecdote. Two-star restriction is supplied by this case, not stated by the commenter.
cases.comparison: Exactly two-star Nidalee with three completed items: Rapidfire emblem plus two explicitly AP-oriented ordinary items versus those same two items plus an ordinary third item. Separate exact third items and observable Rapidfire breakpoints; compare board investment and common supporting cores.
unresolved_evidence: Board investment and emblem source if observed

cases.title: Ahri double Blue Buff outside the simulator

cases.origin: Directly observed discussion need adapted into ranked endgame investigation. Two-star restriction and matching constraints are supplied, not verbatim.
cases.comparison: Exactly two-star Ahri with three completed ordinary items: two Blue Buffs plus a shared damage item versus one Blue Buff plus the shared item plus a second damage item. Show Shojin alternatives separately. Examine recurring allied cores and observed Blossom, Spellweaver and Invoker context.
